title: Integrating Background Knowledge for Scalable Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2607.10456v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Expert background knowledge is often available in practical applications of causal discovery. Such constraints on the true causal graph can help causal discovery in terms of identifiability of causal effects and accuracy of the learned structure, but also in reducing the space of candidate causal graphs. As causal discovery can become computationally expensive for large number of variables, it is crucial to utilize background knowledge effectively during the causal discovery process. However, most current methods only use background knowledge in a postprocessing step after causal discovery to refine the learned graph. In this work, we develop a framework for utilizing background knowledge during the causal discovery process, focusing especially on scalable causal discovery methods that recover only a subset of the whole graph. translated_title: 整合背景知识以实现可扩展的因果发现
translated_abstract: 在因果发现的实际应用中，专家背景知识往往是可获得的。这类对真实因果图的约束能够在因果效应的可识别性和学习结构的准确性方面帮助因果发现，同时还能缩小候选因果图的搜索空间。由于在变量数量众多时因果发现的计算开销可能变得非常昂贵，因此在因果发现过程中有效利用背景知识至关重要。然而，目前大多数方法仅在因果发现完成后的后处理步骤中使用背景知识来精炼学习到的图。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个在因果发现过程中利用背景知识的框架，尤其关注仅恢复整个图的一部分子集的可扩展因果发现方法。我们为多种算法实现了该框架，并通过实验证明，利用背景知识（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个在因果发现过程中（而非仅作为事后后处理）整合专家背景知识的框架，并针对仅恢复部分图结构的大规模可扩展因果发现方法进行了多算法实现与实验验证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a framework that integrates expert background knowledge during the causal discovery process—rather than merely as post-processing—with a focus on scalable methods that recover only a subset of the full graph, implemented across multiple algorithms and validated empirically.
